question: Will England beat Croatia in their Nov 12, 2026 match (19:45 UTC, 90 min + stoppage time only)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the official full-time score of the England vs. Croatia UEFA Nations League match played at Wembley Stadium on 12 November 2026 (kick-off 19:45 UTC), recorded strictly after 2026-11-08T22:00:10.394Z and at or before 2026-11-13T04:45:00.000Z, shows England scoring more goals than Croatia after 90 minutes plus any referee-added stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalties).
- "No": Wins if the official full-time score of the same match shows Croatia scoring more goals than England, or the two sides are level, after 90 minutes plus any referee-added stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalties).

Clarifications:
- Result is determined solely by the scoreline at the conclusion of regulation time (90 minutes plus stoppage time); any subsequent extra time or penalty shootout does not affect settlement.
- If the match is postponed, abandoned, or cancelled and no official full-time result is recorded within the window, the market resolves based on whatever official result UEFA declares; if no official result is declared by 2026-11-13T04:45:00.000Z, the market is unresolvable.
